This study is part of CM3070 final year project. You will use AI.FIT for one week and then answer ten questions about its usability.
The app records a short voice entry and a meal photograph. The recording and the photograph are deleted after they are analysed. The app keeps the voice transcript it generates from the recording, and the model results it gets from the photograph and the calculated risk score.
Your name will be collected and anonymized so that it can be shown a real person took part. No contact number or email address will be collected. All entries will be deleted once the project has been marked.
Results are reported only as an overall score and any feedback received will only be used to improve the project.
Your data is handled appropriately according to Singapore's Personal Data Protection Act. You can stop at any point and ask for your responses to be removed.
